facts.fact: 消息传来时，罗克韦只有两名女性救生队副队长——作者和 Kim Lonergan。
facts.anchor: two women lieutenants in Rockaway—me and Kim Lonergan

facts.fact: 1988 年夏天，作者被任命为纽约市象征性的「第一位女性救生队长」。
facts.anchor: the symbolic “first female chief” lifeguard of New York City

facts.fact: 为掩人耳目，作者对外谎称自己任教的学校是 PS 231，实际在 JHS 223。
facts.anchor: I said I was at PS 231 when I was in JHS 223.

facts.fact: 作者手下两名头牌救生员 Bert Kis 与 Mike Doda 搭档，累计完成三百多次救援。
facts.anchor: Together they did over three hundred rescues

facts.fact: Stein 的干将 Sher 辱骂新救生员，谁不合他心意就让谁在游泳测试上不及格。
facts.anchor: failed people on the swim test if he didn’t like them

facts.fact: 1990 年 6 月的一个夏日，Anthony St. Agathe（十四岁）与 Bugani Wilson（十五岁）到海滩玩，下水后被离岸流卷走。
facts.anchor: St. Agathe and Bugani Wilson were fourteen and fifteen

facts.fact: 庭审上 Regina 崩溃作证，说 Stein 指使她在溺亡事故后伪造报告。
facts.anchor: Stein had made her falsify the reports after the drowning

facts.fact: 官司之后，纽约市最终赔了两百万美元。
facts.anchor: The city ended up paying $2 million to them.
